author: smuzaffar
body:
Fix GCC 15 [warning](https://cmssdt.cern.ch/SDT/jenkins-artifacts/pull-request-integration/PR-02a350/55832/build-logs/DQMServices/Core/log.html)

```
src/DQMServices/Core/src/DQMStore.cc: In member function 'dqm::implementation::NavigatorBase::setCurrentFolder(std::__cxx11::basic_string<char, std::char_traits<char>, std::allocator<char> > const&)':
  [src/DQMServices/Core/src/DQMStore.cc:39](https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/blob/CMSSW_20_1_X_2026-09-11-2300/DQMServices/Core/src/DQMStore.cc#L39):5: warning: 'nonnull' argument 'this' compared to NULL [-Wnonnull-compare]
    39 |     assert(this);
```

reported by GCC15
title: assert(this) is always true as for non-static function it is always non-null
